archetypes.name: step3-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 status routing and sentinel behavior are orchestration-critical.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new plan-review normalize-status path against the old wrapper contract. Focus on status back-map and forward-map ordering, zero-coverage panel failure normalization, result-env synthesis, and summary exit codes. Check that apply-pending and vote statuses do not synthesize terminal sentinels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: warn-replay
archetypes.rationale: Machine stdout ordering is fragile around WARN replay and overlay handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the quiet read-result-env helper and two-stage WARN replay contract. Verify selected-source WARN/ERROR lines are emitted once before the canonical envelope, overlay WARN lines only appear when the primary result env is regular, and markdown warnings stay on stderr. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
